methods.label: Use the average as the midpoint
methods.explanation:
The average of two temperatures lies halfway between them. Since the high and low are \(16\) degrees apart, the low is \(16\div2=8\) degrees below their average. Thus the low temperature was
\[
3-8=\boxed{-5\text{ degrees}}.
\]
The answer is \(\text{C}\).
